background.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original editable adventure-game room background master, later converted to 320x144 pixels
Primary request: Warm sitcom garage interior in a 1990s VGA point-and-click painterly pixel-art style, cinematic amber illumination and deep muted indigo shadows, crisp clustered pixels and warm ochre plaster matching a Mediterranean cottage porch and kitchen. New original scenery, no copied room.
Composition: extremely wide 20:9 panorama, camera level, straight-on wall and shallow floor perspective. At far left x3%-13% a clearly open narrow pedestrian doorway back to a warmly lit porch, doorway bottom at85% image height. Main garage wall is a pleasantly worn cream/ochre plaster with timber roof beams and a few quiet workshop shelves HIGH ABOVE play area. Upper 30% has low-detail rafters. An empty broad pale wall from x32%-78%,y32%-74% reserved for separately composited PA hardware and a small slate; DO NOT paint these props. On far right x93%-100% a broad open scenic garage boundary into dusk, clean walkable edge, not another interior door. Clean smooth warm stone floor occupies bottom25%, with an uninterrupted open walking strip bottom13%. Empty prop parking floor at x14%-28%,y64%-86%. Empty space for people at x28%, x37%, x84%. Light comes from warm ceiling bulbs and porch, while open right edge is softly purple-blue.
Constraints: no people, no PA, no loudspeaker, no microphone, no cables, no cart, no workbench in center, no written text, no icons, no cars, no foreground clutter, no border or vignette. Entire image fills canvas. Background only, friendly inhabited workshop, polished original game environment. Pixel art must retain simple readable structures at 320x144, no pseudo-3D renderer gloss.

props.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original adventure game PA puzzle sprite component master sheet, transparent background
Primary request: Create 16 separately isolated, large pixel-art components on an exact 4 columns by 4 rows grid. Warm golden-lit 1980s portable public-address equipment, painterly VGA adventure game pixels with dark brown and indigo contours. Orthographic three-quarter frontal props, friendly sitcom garage. No people or scenery. Every cell has broad transparent gutters, each subject entirely contained in its cell. All variants of same object match material, size and lighting. NO titles, cell numbers or labels outside objects.
Exact cells, left to right, top to bottom:
Row1 cell1: squat portable wooden PA amplifier console, walnut case dark charcoal fascia, horizontal proportions 1.5:1, cream blank control label strips, big simple rocker switch and round socket on fascia, no text, four short feet. Row1 cell2: a square walnut loudspeaker on a sturdy metal U-shaped swivel yoke and short stand, seen from BACK, solid rear panel and central wire, obvious handle extending from lower left of yoke. Row1 cell3: SAME loudspeaker rotated RIGHT toward a person on its right, its perforated DARK FRONT GRILLE clearly visible on right-facing oblique plane, same yoke and base. Row1 cell4: SAME loudspeaker rotated to face FRONT slightly right toward audience, broad clear perforated DARK FRONT GRILLE, same yoke and base.
Row2 cell1: vintage handheld black microphone upright on a slender short desk/low floor stand, silver mesh oval head, small cream badge with exactly THREE dark dots in a horizontal row, stable three-legged base, no cable. Row2 cell2: separate flexible dark microphone cable in a wide shallow loop, LEFT end from stand base low left, RIGHT end loose angled silver jack with a cream badge with exactly THREE dark dots; no stand. Row2 cell3: same looping microphone cable with RIGHT end raised upward to a horizontal silver plug pointing right; same three-dot badge; no stand. Row2 cell4: empty practical wooden handcart with two visible large dark wheels, flat plank platform, upright handle on left, very readable silhouette.
Row3 cell1: small wooden framed cream equipment-credit slate on a tiny tabletop easel, blank flat writing surface, no words. Row3 cell2: original orange-and-cream cassette tape cartridge lying angled very slightly with visible two reels and blank label. Row3 cell3: cream rectangular input selector plate with two simple pictograms side by side, cassette icon left and microphone icon right, dark toggle pointing LEFT, blank room ABOVE each icon for a later text overlay. Row3 cell4: identical selector plate but dark toggle points RIGHT.
Row4 cell1: small square cream metal MIC socket panel, circular dark socket in upper half, exactly THREE dark dots horizontally in lower half. Row4 cell2: identical panel with visible silver plug inserted into socket, short dark cable leaving left, THREE dark dots still visible. Row4 cell3: painted pale teal oval floor listening mark with a single simple pair of white shoe silhouettes, perspective flattened ellipse, no letters. Row4 cell4: painted pale warm yellow triangular floor listening mark with three small simple white head-and-shoulder silhouettes in a row, perspective flattened triangle, no letters.
Constraints: genuine transparent background. All16 objects must be separate, no overlaps, no shadows outside each local object. Crisp pixel clusters, no antialiasing at the pixel-art aesthetic level, strong contours, no photoreal finish, no invented brand logos. Sheet is design source for scaling to tiny gameplay sprites.
